_notes.env_support: OMP LSP clients that honor 'env' will increase the Node heap for the TypeScript and ESLint language servers. If your client ignores 'env', set NODE_OPTIONS in the shell that launches OMP, or create a wrapper script that exports NODE_OPTIONS before exec'ing the server.
_notes.memory_tuning: 4096 MB balances the M1 8 GB workstation with 4 parallel KIMI streams. Raise to 6144/8192 on machines with more RAM.
_notes.trailing_notes: All original servers, commands, and --stdio arguments preserved; no runtime or build semantics changed.
